source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, everything is looking great! I have a couple of items. I believe there is a glitch in the gallery, and I’ve recorded a clip showing it below. Could we also disable hover animations in the mobile version? Since touching the screen is the only way to hover there, I find the effect somewhat jarring. It would also be a bonus if the mobile pricing sheet could be reformatted so all information is visible without scrolling right. I understand if it is too late to make [PERSON_NAME_004] change because implementation of the site has already begun. Lastly, can the home-screen buttons link to the relevant pages—gallery, pricing, and services? Currently, they appear to return users to the top of the home page.

value_updates.mobile_table_interaction: show all pricing information without requiring horizontal scrolling

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Hello [PERSON_NAME_001],

We know about the gallery glitch. The gallery currently contains placeholder images while we wait to receive the final images from you. We would rather replace the images first and fix the glitch afterward, because resolving it now could lead to the same problem recurring when the images are changed.

We’ll remove the mobile hover animations as well. We agree [PERSON_NAME_004] hover effects are not ideal for the user experience on touch screens.

For the pricing table, we recommend retaining horizontal scrolling on smaller screens. Because the table includes several columns, this is the most practical option for keeping all information readable on mobile devices. Alternatively, we could fix the first column in place and let the other columns scroll horizontally, similar to the mobile implementation here: [URL_010]. Please tell us which option you prefer, or whether you have another solution in mind.

As requested, we’ll also revise the homepage buttons so they lead directly to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages.

We’ll begin making these changes and send you an update. In the meantime, please share your preferred pricing-table approach so we can implement the option [PERSON_NAME_004] suits you best.

[PERSON_NAME_003] you! 🙂

ambiguity.description: The client requested a layout without horizontal scrolling, while the agency recommended retaining horizontal scrolling or fixing the first column and requested a client decision.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: [PERSON_NAME_004] works well. The animations look great, so let’s retain them. The current pricing approach is fine for now. I’ll think through other possibilities and update you if anything changes. Also, how many photos should I provide for the gallery to be set up correctly? I’m selecting them from my portfolio now.

value_updates.mobile_table_interaction: retain horizontal scrolling on smaller screens
